title: 展望台と里の文化
theme: a mountain lookout, campsite and village temple in rural Japan, realistic photographic materials

cells.name: 展望台の木材
cells.prompt: weathered grey-brown structural timber of a wooden lookout tower with bolts and checks, grain running top to bottom, about 1 m across

cells.name: テントの生地
cells.prompt: taut orange and olive ripstop nylon tent fabric with seams and a slight sheen, about 1 m across

cells.name: ピクニックテーブル材
cells.prompt: varnished pine picnic table planks with small gaps, worn edges, boards running left to right, about 1 m across

cells.name: 焚き火
cells.prompt: top view of a campfire: charred logs, glowing orange embers and grey ash in a ring of stones, filling the whole square

cells.name: お地蔵さま
cells.prompt: front view of a small weathered Japanese stone jizo statue wearing a red cloth bib, mossy granite, plain dark background, no text, filling the whole square

cells.name: 梵鐘の青銅
cells.prompt: dark aged bronze of a Japanese temple bell with raised nipple bosses in a grid and green patina, about 1 m across

cells.name: 赤い提灯
cells.prompt: glowing red Japanese paper lantern (chochin) surface with thin bamboo ribs running left to right, warm light shining through, no text, about 0.6 m across

cells.name: 石の鳥居
cells.prompt: weathered pale granite of an old stone torii with lichen spots and rain streaks, about 1 m across

cells.name: 稲架掛け
cells.prompt: bundles of golden rice straw hung to dry on a wooden rack (hazagake), dense straw stalks running top to bottom, about 1 m across
